import Mathlib

inductive SplayTree
| empty
| node (val : Int) (left right : SplayTree)
deriving Inhabited

namespace SplayTree

def view (t : SplayTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | empty => ∅
  | node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}
termination_by sizeOf t

def is_bst (t : SplayTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | empty => True
  | node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def val (t : SplayTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with | node v _ _ => some v | empty => none

def is_node (t : SplayTree) : Bool :=
  match t with | node _ _ _ => true | empty => false

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def splay_precond (t : SplayTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  t.is_node ∧ is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def rotR (x : Int) (t r : SplayTree) : SplayTree :=
  match t with
  | .empty => .node x .empty r
  | .node y ll lr => .node y ll (.node x lr r)

def rotL (x : Int) (l t : SplayTree) : SplayTree :=
  match t with
  | .empty => .node x l .empty
  | .node y rl rr => .node y (.node x l rl) rr

def mtr (t : SplayTree) (v : Int) : SplayTree :=
  match t with
  | .empty => .empty
  | .node x l r =>
    if v < x then rotR x (mtr l v) r
    else if x < v then rotL x l (mtr r v)
    else .node x l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def splay (t : SplayTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : splay_precond t v) : SplayTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  mtr t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def splay_postcond (t : SplayTree) (v : Int) (result : SplayTree)
    (_ : splay_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.is_node ∧
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  (v ∈ view t → result.val = some v)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_empty : view .empty = (∅ : Set Int) := by
  simp only [view]

theorem view_node (x : Int) (l r : SplayTree) :
    view (.node x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} := by
  simp only [view]

theorem is_bst_node (x : Int) (l r : SplayTree) :
    is_bst (.node x l r) ↔
      ((∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ y ∈ view r, y > x) ∧ is_bst r) := by
  simp only [is_bst]

theorem mem_view_node_left {z x : Int} {l r : SplayTree} (h : z ∈ view l) :
    z ∈ view (.node x l r) := by
  rw [view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

theorem mem_view_node_right {z x : Int} {l r : SplayTree} (h : z ∈ view r) :
    z ∈ view (.node x l r) := by
  rw [view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

theorem mem_view_node_self (x : Int) (l r : SplayTree) : x ∈ view (.node x l r) := by
  rw [view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

theorem view_rotR (x : Int) (t r : SplayTree) :
    view (rotR x t r) = view t ∪ view r ∪ {x} := by
  cases t with
  | empty => simp only [rotR, view_node]
  | node y ll lr =>
    simp only [rotR, view_node]
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto

theorem view_rotL (x : Int) (l t : SplayTree) :
    view (rotL x l t) = view l ∪ view t ∪ {x} := by
  cases t with
  | empty => simp only [rotL, view_node]
  | node y rl rr =>
    simp only [rotL, view_node]
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto

theorem is_node_rotR (x : Int) (t r : SplayTree) : (rotR x t r).is_node = true := by
  cases t <;> rfl

theorem is_node_rotL (x : Int) (l t : SplayTree) : (rotL x l t).is_node = true := by
  cases t <;> rfl

theorem val_rotR (x w : Int) (t r : SplayTree) (h : t.val = some w) :
    (rotR x t r).val = some w := by
  cases t with
  | empty =>
    exfalso
    simp only [val] at h
    exact Option.noConfusion h
  | node y ll lr =>
    simp only [val] at h
    simp only [rotR, val]
    exact h

theorem val_rotL (x w : Int) (l t : SplayTree) (h : t.val = some w) :
    (rotL x l t).val = some w := by
  cases t with
  | empty =>
    exfalso
    simp only [val] at h
    exact Option.noConfusion h
  | node y rl rr =>
    simp only [val] at h
    simp only [rotL, val]
    exact h

theorem is_bst_rotR (x : Int) (t r : SplayTree)
    (h1 : ∀ y ∈ view t, y < x) (h2 : is_bst t)
    (h3 : ∀ y ∈ view r, y > x) (h4 : is_bst r) :
    is_bst (rotR x t r) := by
  cases t with
  | empty =>
    simp only [rotR]
    rw [is_bst_node]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  | node y ll lr =>
    rw [is_bst_node] at h2
    obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hD⟩ := h2
    have hyx : y < x := h1 y (mem_view_node_self y ll lr)
    simp only [rotR]
    rw [is_bst_node]
    refine ⟨hA, hB, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hz
      rw [view_node] at hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      rcases hz with (hz | hz) | hz
      · exact hC z hz
      · have hzx := h3 z hz
        omega
      · omega
    · rw [is_bst_node]
      refine ⟨?_, hD, h3, h4⟩
      intro z hz
      exact h1 z (mem_view_node_right hz)

theorem is_bst_rotL (x : Int) (l t : SplayTree)
    (h1 : ∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) (h2 : is_bst l)
    (h3 : ∀ y ∈ view t, y > x) (h4 : is_bst t) :
    is_bst (rotL x l t) := by
  cases t with
  | empty =>
    simp only [rotL]
    rw [is_bst_node]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  | node y rl rr =>
    rw [is_bst_node] at h4
    obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hD⟩ := h4
    have hxy : x < y := h3 y (mem_view_node_self y rl rr)
    simp only [rotL]
    rw [is_bst_node]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hC, hD⟩
    · intro z hz
      rw [view_node] at hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      rcases hz with (hz | hz) | hz
      · have hzx := h1 z hz
        omega
      · exact hA z hz
      · omega
    · rw [is_bst_node]
      refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_, hB⟩
      intro z hz
      exact h3 z (mem_view_node_left hz)

theorem view_mtr (t : SplayTree) (v : Int) : view (mtr t v) = view t := by
  induction t with
  | empty => simp only [mtr]
  | node x l r ihl ihr =>
    simp only [mtr]
    split_ifs with hc1 hc2
    · rw [view_rotR, ihl, view_node]
    · rw [view_rotL, ihr, view_node]
    · rfl

theorem is_node_mtr (t : SplayTree) (v : Int) (h : t.is_node = true) :
    (mtr t v).is_node = true := by
  cases t with
  | empty =>
    exfalso
    simp only [is_node] at h
    exact Bool.noConfusion h
  | node x l r =>
    simp only [mtr]
    split_ifs with hc1 hc2
    · exact is_node_rotR x (mtr l v) r
    · exact is_node_rotL x l (mtr r v)
    · rfl

theorem is_bst_mtr (v : Int) : ∀ (t : SplayTree), is_bst t → is_bst (mtr t v) := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | empty =>
    intro h
    simp only [mtr]
    exact h
  | node x l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
    simp only [mtr]
    split_ifs with hc1 hc2
    · refine is_bst_rotR x (mtr l v) r ?_ (ihl h2) h3 h4
      intro y hy
      rw [view_mtr] at hy
      exact h1 y hy
    · refine is_bst_rotL x l (mtr r v) h1 h2 ?_ (ihr h4)
      intro y hy
      rw [view_mtr] at hy
      exact h3 y hy
    · rw [is_bst_node]
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩

theorem val_mtr (v : Int) : ∀ (t : SplayTree), is_bst t → v ∈ view t →
    (mtr t v).val = some v := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | empty =>
    intro _ hv
    rw [view_empty] at hv
    exact absurd hv (by simp)
  | node x l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h hv
    rw [is_bst_node] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
    rw [view_node] at hv
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    simp only [mtr]
    split_ifs with hc1 hc2
    · have hvl : v ∈ view l := by
        rcases hv with (hv | hv) | hv
        · exact hv
        · have hvx := h3 v hv
          exfalso; omega
        · exfalso; omega
      exact val_rotR x v (mtr l v) r (ihl h2 hvl)
    · have hvr : v ∈ view r := by
        rcases hv with (hv | hv) | hv
        · have hvx := h1 v hv
          exfalso; omega
        · exact hv
        · exfalso; omega
      exact val_rotL x v l (mtr r v) (ihr h4 hvr)
    · have hx : v = x := by omega
      simp only [val, hx]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem splay_postcond_satisfied (t : SplayTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : splay_precond t v) :
    splay_postcond t v (splay t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hn, hb⟩ := h_precond
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [splay]
    exact is_node_mtr t v hn
  · simp only [splay]
    exact is_bst_mtr v t hb
  · simp only [splay]
    exact view_mtr t v
  · intro hv
    simp only [splay]
    exact val_mtr v t hb hv
  -- !benchmark @end proof

end SplayTree

**Approach.** Rather than implementing full splay with zig-zig/zig-zag (which only affects efficiency, not the postconditions), I implement the classical *move-to-root* variant, which is built from single rotations and satisfies exactly the required postconditions:

```
mtr (node x l r) v =
  if v < x then rotR x (mtr l v) r
  else if x < v then rotL x l (mtr r v)
  else node x l r
```

where `rotR x t r` rotates the root of `t` up over `x` (and `rotL` symmetrically). If `t` is empty, the rotation just rebuilds `node x t r`, keeping everything valid.

**Key facts to prove:**

1. `view (rotR x t r) = view t ∪ view r ∪ {x}` and the symmetric one — rotations preserve the value set.
2. Rotations preserve BST-ness given the local BST hypotheses.
3. Rotations always give a node, and propagate the root value of the rotated subtree.
4. By induction: `view (mtr t v) = view t`, `is_bst t → is_bst (mtr t v)`, `is_node t → is_node (mtr t v)`, and (using BST-ness to know that `v < x` forces `v ∈ view l`) `v ∈ view t → (mtr t v).val = some v`.

Then `splay t v _ := mtr t v` and the postcondition follows directly.
